welcomeCopy: A closer look at Bruma. Explore the collection, care for each order, and see a coffee store come together.
shared: A shared portfolio demo. Changes are visible to everyone; purchases are simulated.
loadingCopy: The demo service may take a moment to wake up. Your next ritual is on its way.
connectionCopy: Please try again in a moment. Your selection stays with you.
renewed: Demo access renewed. You can retry your changes.
stockLimit: Your bag has reached the available stock for this variant.
editCopy: Prices are shared by whole bean and ground coffee of the same weight. Changes are visible to all visitors.
reviewTitle: A small change to your selection.
reviewCopy: Prices or available bags have changed. Review the current selection, apply the changes, then confirm your order from the final review.
emptyReview: These variants are no longer available. Return to your bag to choose another coffee.

states.missing: This order is no longer in the shared demo. It may have been reset.
states.error: Status couldn’t be checked. Your receipt is saved locally.

ordersCopy: From a good choice to a finished ritual.
noOrders: No orders yet. Make a demo purchase to begin.
cancelCopy: The order will be cancelled and its bags returned to stock. This action cannot be undone.
overviewCopy: Good coffee, cared for. A little perspective on your store.
stockNote: Five bags or fewer · all stock
trendAlt: Daily product sales. Expand the table below to read every value.
noSales: No sales in this period yet.
healthyStock: Every variant has more than five bags in stock.
metricNote: Shared demonstration data · USD · day boundaries in UTC. Sales exclude shipping and cancelled orders; order count includes cancellations.
resetCopy: This restores the sample prices, availability, stock and orders for everyone. Purchases made in this demo will be removed. Your admin access will stay active.
resetDone: The shared demo has been restored.
reviewDraft: Review the current values below, then save your draft again.
reorderStockLimit: Only the available bags can be added.

errors.rate_limited: The shared demo is busy. Please try again shortly.
errors.order_conflict: Another visitor changed this order, or this step is no longer available. Review its current state.
errors.validation: Check the entered values and try again.
errors.edit_conflict: Another visitor changed this coffee. Your draft is kept; compare the current values before saving again.
errors.store_reset: The shared demo was reset. Review the latest selection before trying again.
errors.session_expired: Your demo access expired. Enter again below, then retry your changes.
errors.server_error: The changes could not be saved. Your entries are kept; please try again.
